title: Feature inventory
description: Every cataloged page and control with how often it was used, least used first. Catalog: feature_catalog enrichment table.

panels.title: Pages: sessions and views, least used first
panels.description: Every page row in the catalog. Sessions that opened the page at least once, and views that stayed open a second or more. Zero means no recorded browser opened it in the selected time range; check Collection coverage before calling it unused.

queries.query: SELECT c.app, c.feature_name AS feature, count(DISTINCT v.session_id) AS sessions, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.spent >= 1e9 THEN v.view_id END) AS views, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(v.ts)), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS last_used_utc, c.feature_id FROM enrich.feature_catalog c LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(view_url, '^https?://[^/]+|[?][^#]*', '', 'g'), '(.)/(#|$)', '$1$2') AS path, max(view_time_spent) AS spent, min(_timestamp) AS ts FROM (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) UNION ALL SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app))) GROUP BY service, session_id, view_id, path) v ON v.service = c.app AND regexp_like(v.path, c.path_pattern) WHERE c.kind = 'page' AND (c.app IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY c.app, c.feature_name, c.feature_id ORDER BY sessions ASC, views ASC, c.app, feature

panels.title: Controls: uses and sessions, least used first
panels.description: Every control row in the catalog: clicks, changes, and submits on that label on that page. writes = y means it changes state. Controls with no visible text or aria-label cannot be told apart and are not in the catalog.

queries.query: SELECT c.app, c.feature_name AS feature, c.element_label AS label, c.writes, count(s.span_id) AS uses, count(DISTINCT s.rum_session_id) AS sessions, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(s._timestamp)), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS last_used_utc, c.feature_id FROM enrich.feature_catalog c LEFT JOIN "default" s ON s.service_name = c.app AND s.event_type IN ('click', 'change', 'submit') AND s.target_text = c.element_label AND regexp_like(regexp_replace(s.page_path, '(.)/$', '$1'), c.path_pattern) WHERE c.kind = 'control' AND (c.app IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY c.app, c.feature_name, c.element_label, c.writes, c.feature_id ORDER BY uses ASC, c.app, feature

panels.title: Pages: used vs never used, per app
panels.description: Cataloged pages per app, split by whether any session opened them.

queries.query: SELECT app, count(*) AS cataloged, sum(CASE WHEN sessions > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS used, sum(CASE WHEN sessions = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS never_used FROM (SELECT c.app, c.feature_name AS feature, count(DISTINCT v.session_id) AS sessions, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.spent >= 1e9 THEN v.view_id END) AS views, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(v.ts)), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS last_used_utc, c.feature_id FROM enrich.feature_catalog c LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(view_url, '^https?://[^/]+|[?][^#]*', '', 'g'), '(.)/(#|$)', '$1$2') AS path, max(view_time_spent) AS spent, min(_timestamp) AS ts FROM (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) UNION ALL SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app))) GROUP BY service, session_id, view_id, path) v ON v.service = c.app AND regexp_like(v.path, c.path_pattern) WHERE c.kind = 'page' AND (c.app IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY c.app, c.feature_name, c.feature_id) GROUP BY app ORDER BY app

panels.title: Controls: used vs never used, per app
panels.description: Cataloged controls per app, split by whether anyone used them.

queries.query: SELECT app, count(*) AS cataloged, sum(CASE WHEN uses > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS used, sum(CASE WHEN uses = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS never_used FROM (SELECT c.app, c.feature_name AS feature, c.element_label AS label, c.writes, count(s.span_id) AS uses, count(DISTINCT s.rum_session_id) AS sessions, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(s._timestamp)), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS last_used_utc, c.feature_id FROM enrich.feature_catalog c LEFT JOIN "default" s ON s.service_name = c.app AND s.event_type IN ('click', 'change', 'submit') AND s.target_text = c.element_label AND regexp_like(regexp_replace(s.page_path, '(.)/$', '$1'), c.path_pattern) WHERE c.kind = 'control' AND (c.app IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY c.app, c.feature_name, c.element_label, c.writes, c.feature_id) GROUP BY app ORDER BY app

panels.title: Low use pages: opened in only 1 or 2 sessions
panels.description: One row per session. Click a row to open its replay.

queries.query: SELECT f.app, f.feature, x.session_id, x.start_us AS started, x.start_us, x.end_us FROM (SELECT c.feature_id, c.app, c.feature_name AS feature FROM enrich.feature_catalog c JOIN (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(view_url, '^https?://[^/]+|[?][^#]*', '', 'g'), '(.)/(#|$)', '$1$2') AS path, max(view_time_spent) AS spent, min(_timestamp) AS ts FROM (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) UNION ALL SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app))) GROUP BY service, session_id, view_id, path) v ON v.service = c.app AND regexp_like(v.path, c.path_pattern) WHERE c.kind = 'page' GROUP BY c.feature_id, c.app, c.feature_name HAVING count(DISTINCT v.session_id) <= 2) f JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT c.feature_id, v.session_id FROM enrich.feature_catalog c JOIN (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(view_url, '^https?://[^/]+|[?][^#]*', '', 'g'), '(.)/(#|$)', '$1$2') AS path, max(view_time_spent) AS spent, min(_timestamp) AS ts FROM (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) UNION ALL SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app))) GROUP BY service, session_id, view_id, path) v ON v.service = c.app AND regexp_like(v.path, c.path_pattern) WHERE c.kind = 'page') fs ON fs.feature_id = f.feature_id JOIN (SELECT session_id, min(_timestamp) AS start_us, max(_timestamp) AS end_us FROM (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) UNION ALL SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app))) GROUP BY session_id) x ON x.session_id = fs.session_id ORDER BY f.app, f.feature, started

panels.title: Low use controls: used in only 1 or 2 sessions
panels.description: One row per session. Click a row to open its replay around the time the control was used.

queries.query: SELECT f.app, f.feature, f.label, s.rum_session_id AS session_id, min(s._timestamp) AS used_at, min(s._timestamp) - 600000000 AS start_us, max(s._timestamp) + 600000000 AS end_us FROM (SELECT c.feature_id, c.app, c.feature_name AS feature, c.element_label AS label, c.path_pattern FROM enrich.feature_catalog c JOIN "default" s ON s.service_name = c.app AND s.event_type IN ('click', 'change', 'submit') AND s.target_text = c.element_label AND regexp_like(regexp_replace(s.page_path, '(.)/$', '$1'), c.path_pattern) WHERE c.kind = 'control' AND (c.app IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY c.feature_id, c.app, c.feature_name, c.element_label, c.path_pattern HAVING count(DISTINCT s.rum_session_id) <= 2) f JOIN "default" s ON s.service_name = f.app AND s.event_type IN ('click', 'change', 'submit') AND s.target_text = f.label AND regexp_like(regexp_replace(s.page_path, '(.)/$', '$1'), f.path_pattern) GROUP BY f.app, f.feature, f.label, s.rum_session_id ORDER BY f.app, f.feature, used_at

panels.title: Pages seen that are not in the catalog
panels.description: Page paths (query string dropped) that matched no catalog row. Add rows for real features so they show in the inventory.

queries.query: SELECT v.service AS app, v.path AS page, count(DISTINCT v.session_id) AS sessions, count(DISTINCT v.view_id) AS views FROM (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(view_url, '^https?://[^/]+|[?][^#]*', '', 'g'), '(.)/(#|$)', '$1$2') AS path, max(view_time_spent) AS spent, min(_timestamp) AS ts FROM (SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "_rumdata" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) UNION ALL SELECT service, session_id, view_id, view_url, view_time_spent, view_loading_type, _timestamp FROM "ui_views" WHERE type = 'view' AND (service IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app))) GROUP BY service, session_id, view_id, path) v LEFT JOIN enrich.feature_catalog c ON c.app = v.service AND c.kind = 'page' AND regexp_like(v.path, c.path_pattern) WHERE c.feature_id IS NULL AND v.spent >= 1e9 GROUP BY v.service, v.path ORDER BY sessions DESC, views DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Labelled controls used that are not in the catalog
panels.description: Clicked or changed controls with a label that matched no catalog row. Links, sidebar entries, and Java tab headers are left out; they show up as page views.

queries.query: SELECT s.service_name AS app, regexp_replace(s.page_path, '(.)/$', '$1') AS page, s.target_text AS label, count(*) AS uses, count(DISTINCT s.rum_session_id) AS sessions FROM "default" s LEFT JOIN enrich.feature_catalog c ON c.app = s.service_name AND c.kind = 'control' AND s.target_text = c.element_label AND regexp_like(regexp_replace(s.page_path, '(.)/$', '$1'), c.path_pattern) WHERE c.feature_id IS NULL AND s.event_type IN ('click', 'change', 'submit') AND s.target_text <> '' AND s.target_element NOT IN ('A', 'BODY', 'HTML', 'JTabbedPane', 'TabPane') AND s.target_xpath NOT LIKE '%/a/%' AND s.target_xpath NOT LIKE '%/nav/%' AND (s.service_name IN ($app) OR '_o2_all_' IN ($app)) GROUP BY s.service_name, regexp_replace(s.page_path, '(.)/$', '$1'), s.target_text ORDER BY sessions DESC, uses DESC LIMIT 25
